title: connections.json of an agent template: the source classes it reads and writes, each with its connector and grant

source_class.description: a class of source (a tracker, a chat, a store), never one installation

grant.description: the grant or scope it needs, by name; never a value

when.description: the condition under which an optional connection is needed, or under which a required one applies

scope.description: what the direction covers, in words ("draft pull requests only")

spends.description: true when a call through it costs money (rule A6)
